newsitem.title: USA: Primergy merger pulled from U.S. FERC agenda.
newsitem.headline: Primergy merger pulled from U.S. FERC agenda.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Tuesday postponed a scheduled decision on a proposed merger between Northern States Power Co and Wisconsin Energy Corp.
A FERC spokeswoman said the commissioners did not give a reason for delaying the vote originally slated for Wednesday, and did not reschedule it.

The proposed $6 billion combination of the two upper midwestern utilities into a holding company called Primergy Corp would be the biggest merger the commission has considered since it issued guidelines in December on speeding up its merger decisions.
The merger would create a utility serving more than 3 million customers in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota and South Dakota.
Minnesota and Wisconsin state regulators still have not decided on the controversial proposal.
A FERC administrative law judge last summer approved the merger, with several conditions.
